MapaOvCoordinateForm.help: Latitude first, then longitude, in decimal degrees (-9.25) or in degrees, minutes and seconds (9°15'00"S). South and west are negative.

errors.oppositeCorners: The corners must be opposite: no repeated latitude or longitude.
errors.collinear: The vertices are collinear and do not form an area.

coverage.partial: Part of the area is outside the Caatinga: the layers do not cover the outer stretch.
coverage.outside: Outside the Caatinga: the layers do not cover this location.
